Aggressive preset removes nav, footer, aside unconditionally

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"preprocessing\":{\"preset\":\"Aggressive\"}}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<nav>Menu</nav><article><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></article><aside>Sidebar</aside><footer>Footer</footer>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
